completion_definition: Completed means an initial curated cross-reference pass: the complete supplied English source unit and each retained target passage were read, and each pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean exhaustive coverage or independent specialist approval.

verses.text: And it happened that, while they were perplexed about this, behold, two men stood beside them in flashing clothing.
verses.display_text: And it happened that, while they were perplexed about this, behold, two men stood beside them in flashing clothing.

verses.text: They became afraid and bowed their faces to the ground, and the men said to them, “Why do you seek the living One among the dead?
verses.display_text: They became afraid and bowed their faces to the ground, and the men said to them, “Why do you seek the living One among the dead?

verses.text: He is not here, but has been raised. Remember how He spoke to you while He was still in Galilee,
verses.display_text: He is not here, but has been raised. Remember how He spoke to you while He was still in Galilee,

verses.text: saying that the Son of Man must be handed over into the hands of sinful people and be crucified and rise on the third day.”
verses.display_text: saying that the Son of Man must be handed over into the hands of sinful people and be crucified and rise on the third day.”

verses.text: And they remembered His words,
verses.display_text: And they remembered His words,

verses.text: and returned from the tomb and reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the rest.
verses.display_text: and returned from the tomb and reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the rest.

verses.text: It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna and Mary of James and the other women with them who told these things to the apostles.
verses.display_text: It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna and Mary of James and the other women with them who told these things to the apostles.

verses.text: But these words seemed to them like nonsense, and they did not believe the women.
verses.display_text: But these words seemed to them like nonsense, and they did not believe the women.

verses.text: Yet Peter rose and ran to the tomb. Stooping to look in, he saw the linen cloths alone, and went away, wondering to himself at what had happened.
verses.display_text: Yet Peter rose and ran to the tomb. Stooping to look in, he saw the linen cloths alone, and went away, wondering to himself at what had happened.

verses.text: And behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village named Emmaus, sixty stadia away from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: And behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village named Emmaus, sixty stadia away from Jerusalem.

verses.text: They were talking with one another about all these things that had happened.
verses.display_text: They were talking with one another about all these things that had happened.

verses.text: And it happened that, as they talked and discussed, Jesus Himself drew near and traveled with them.
verses.display_text: And it happened that, as they talked and discussed, Jesus Himself drew near and traveled with them.

verses.text: But their eyes were held back from recognizing Him.
verses.display_text: But their eyes were held back from recognizing Him.

verses.text: And He said to them, “What are these words you are exchanging with one another as you walk?” And they stood still, downcast.
verses.display_text: And He said to them, “What are these words you are exchanging with one another as you walk?” And they stood still, downcast.

verses.text: One named Cleopas answered Him, “Art Thou the only visitor in Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”
verses.display_text: One named Cleopas answered Him, “Art Thou the only visitor in Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”

verses.text: And He said to them, “What things?” They said to Him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,
verses.display_text: And He said to them, “What things?” They said to Him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,

verses.text: and how our chief priests and rulers handed Him over to a judgment of death and crucified Him.
verses.display_text: and how our chief priests and rulers handed Him over to a judgment of death and crucified Him.

verses.text: But we were hoping that He was the One about to redeem Israel. Yet indeed, besides all these things, this is the third day since these things happened.
verses.display_text: But we were hoping that He was the One about to redeem Israel. Yet indeed, besides all these things, this is the third day since these things happened.

verses.text: Moreover, some women from among us astonished us. They went to the tomb early
verses.display_text: Moreover, some women from among us astonished us. They went to the tomb early

verses.text: and did not find His body, and came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who say that He is alive.
verses.display_text: and did not find His body, and came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who say that He is alive.

verses.text: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but Him they did not see.”
verses.display_text: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but Him they did not see.”

verses.text: And He said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow in heart to believe all that the prophets spoke!
verses.display_text: And He said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow in heart to believe all that the prophets spoke!

verses.text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and enter into His glory?”
verses.display_text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and enter into His glory?”

verses.text: And beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, He interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.
verses.display_text: And beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, He interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

verses.text: They drew near the village to which they were traveling, and He acted as though He would travel farther.
verses.display_text: They drew near the village to which they were traveling, and He acted as though He would travel farther.

verses.text: But they urged Him strongly, saying, “Stay with us, because it is toward evening and the day has already waned.” And He went in to stay with them.
verses.display_text: But they urged Him strongly, saying, “Stay with us, because it is toward evening and the day has already waned.” And He went in to stay with them.

verses.text: And it happened that as He reclined at table with them, He took the bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them.
verses.display_text: And it happened that as He reclined at table with them, He took the bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them.

verses.text: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Him, and He vanished from their sight.
verses.display_text: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Him, and He vanished from their sight.

verses.text: And they said to one another, “Was not our heart burning within us as He spoke to us on the road, as He opened the Scriptures to us?”
verses.display_text: And they said to one another, “Was not our heart burning within us as He spoke to us on the road, as He opened the Scriptures to us?”

verses.text: They rose that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the Eleven and those with them gathered together,
verses.display_text: They rose that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the Eleven and those with them gathered together,

verses.text: saying, “The Lord has truly been raised and has appeared to Simon!”
verses.display_text: saying, “The Lord has truly been raised and has appeared to Simon!”

verses.text: And they related the things that happened on the road, and how He was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
verses.display_text: And they related the things that happened on the road, and how He was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.

verses.text: While they were speaking these things, He Himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”
verses.display_text: While they were speaking these things, He Himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”

verses.text: But they were startled and became afraid, thinking they were seeing a spirit.
verses.display_text: But they were startled and became afraid, thinking they were seeing a spirit.

verses.text: And He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts arise in your heart?
verses.display_text: And He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts arise in your heart?

verses.text: See My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Feel Me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have.”
verses.display_text: See My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Feel Me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have.”

verses.text: And having said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
verses.display_text: And having said this, He showed them His hands and feet.

verses.text: While they still did not believe for joy and were marveling, He said to them, “Do you have anything to eat here?”
verses.display_text: While they still did not believe for joy and were marveling, He said to them, “Do you have anything to eat here?”

verses.text: They gave Him a portion of broiled fish.
verses.display_text: They gave Him a portion of broiled fish.

verses.text: And He took it and ate before them.
verses.display_text: And He took it and ate before them.

verses.text: And He said to them, “These are My words that I spoke to you while I was still with you: everything written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and Psalms must be fulfilled.”
verses.display_text: And He said to them, “These are My words that I spoke to you while I was still with you: everything written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and Psalms must be fulfilled.”

verses.text: Then He opened their mind to understand the Scriptures
verses.display_text: Then He opened their mind to understand the Scriptures

verses.text: and said to them, “Thus it is written that the Christ should suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
verses.display_text: and said to them, “Thus it is written that the Christ should suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

verses.text: and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in His name to all the nations—beginning from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in His name to all the nations—beginning from Jerusalem.

verses.text: You are witnesses of these things.
verses.display_text: You are witnesses of these things.

verses.text: And behold, I am sending out the promise of My Father upon you; but remain in the city until you are clothed with power from on high.”
verses.display_text: And behold, I am sending out the promise of My Father upon you; but remain in the city until you are clothed with power from on high.”

verses.text: And He led them out as far as toward Bethany, and lifted His hands and blessed them.
verses.display_text: And He led them out as far as toward Bethany, and lifted His hands and blessed them.

verses.text: And it happened that while He blessed them, He parted from them and was carried up into heaven.
verses.display_text: And it happened that while He blessed them, He parted from them and was carried up into heaven.

verses.text: And they, having worshiped Him, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.display_text: And they, having worshiped Him, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

verses.text: and were continually in the temple, blessing God.
verses.display_text: and were continually in the temple, blessing God.
